requirements.description: Immutable ABRN Cream (#faf8f5 / #7a1f2b) and ABRN Slate (#1e2330 / #262c3b / #d4aeb0) 1-click topbar switcher, Libre Baskerville serif identity, 62px-238px collapsible rail with ABRN Drive crest and FLUJO CONTABLE actions, and contextual topbar accountant buttons on /files.

Unified subheader with Bóveda ABRN breadcrumb, Blindado · AES-256-GCM emerald pulse pill, 1-click Layout Presets (3 Paneles, Lista Ancha, Lectura), 1px-divided clickable Telemetry Strip, and tactile 10px 4-dot vertical splitters with live px HUD.
CLIENTES Y CARPETAS left pane with + Carpeta, instant client filter input, FIJADOS section, 1-click 5-Subfolder Accountant Standard Template in FolderModal, and folder right-click context actions.

Horizontal subfolder quick-pills, 9 live-count underline filter tabs, day-grouped headers (HOY / ESTA SEMANA / ANTERIORES), 38x38 format thumbnails, inline F2 rename persisted via POST /api/v1/files/sync, zero-reflow Floating In-Grid Action Capsule, persistent Download/Abrir buttons, and Canasta #key StagingDock.

6-format RAM Inspector (PDF, CFDI, XLSX, 4K, Video, Código) with 2x2 Dispatch Deck, Cryptographic Passport, Smart Upload & Auto-Order Modal (triageFileObject + AES-256-GCM subfolder upload), WhatsApp Secure Drop Checklist Modal (POST /api/drop/create + Ya recibido detection), and 94vw Cinemascope FilePreviewModal.

Mobile 390x844 layout, Active Folder Hero, Subfolder Strip, and thumb-first AES-256 cards remain 100% intact with zero overflow, client-side AES-256-GCM and #fragment keys remain preserved, and abrndrive.service is untouched.

findings.reproduction: Stage 2 files in Canasta #key dock on /files and open either VaultContextMenu or a Radix modal dialog.
findings.expected: StagingDock sits above the left sidebar (z-40) without left-edge clipping, while staying underneath Radix modal dialogs (z-50) and VaultContextMenu.
findings.actual: At z-40 StagingDock clipped behind the sidebar; at z-[55] it stacked above Radix modal backdrops (z-50).
findings.cause: Stacking order between sidebar (z-40), StagingDock, Radix Dialog (z-50), and VaultContextMenu needed intermediate layer calibration.
findings.fix: Set StagingDock to z-[45] and VaultContextMenu to z-[60].

findings.reproduction: Open /files at 1440x900 with default 368px VaultInspectorPane width.
findings.expected: All 6 format tabs and all 4 quick dispatch actions in VaultInspectorPane display their full labels without clipping.
findings.actual: XML CFDI truncated to XM... and the 4th single-row dispatch button clipped at 368px width.
findings.cause: Single-row 4-button flex layout and 2-word tab label exceeded 344px inner width.
findings.fix: Shortened tab label to CFDI with whitespace-nowrap and arranged the 4 quick dispatch buttons into a 2x2 grid-cols-2 deck in VaultInspectorPane.tsx.

findings.reproduction: Open Pedir Docs (WhatsAppDropRequestModal) on a client folder that already contains a bank statement PDF.
findings.expected: Items detected as Ya recibido start unchecked so the checklist checkboxes match the filtered WhatsApp message preview.
findings.actual: Estado de Cuenta Bancario del mes displayed the green Ya recibido badge while its checkbox remained checked on initial open.
findings.cause: selectedIds initialized statically before filtering against receivedMap.
findings.fix: Added useEffect in WhatsAppDropRequestModal.tsx syncing selectedIds on open to exclude items where receivedMap[d.id] is true.

findings.expected: Desktop-only .abrn-btn and .abrn-splitter elements with Tailwind hidden class do not render on mobile viewports.
findings.actual: Desktop Subir y Ordenar button and tiny splitter handles remained visible on 390x844 mobile.
findings.cause: Unlayered .abrn-btn and .abrn-splitter display rules in abrn-unified-vault.css had higher CSS cascade priority than Tailwind v4 @layer utilities .hidden.
findings.fix: Wrapped all .abrn-* component classes in abrn-unified-vault.css inside @layer components so Tailwind v4 utility classes win cleanly.

findings.reproduction: Load the 4 sample files in SmartUploadOrderModal, upload the sample CFDI XML, and open it in the 94vw FilePreviewModal.
findings.expected: FilemonOfficeStage parses the sample XML as a full SAT CFDI 4.0 tree and renders the Executive Glass Twin.
findings.actual: Strict XML DOMParser reported unbound cfdi: namespace prefix and fell back to safe escaped source view.
findings.cause: Synthetic sample XML omitted xmlns:cfdi and xmlns:tfd namespace declarations.
findings.fix: Added xmlns:cfdi, xmlns:tfd, Conceptos, and TimbreFiscalDigital UUID attributes to the sample XML in SmartUploadOrderModal.tsx.
